$comment: TCIA closed catalog, format 1. CONTRACT FILE: the engine, the validator and the skill read it; nobody edits it without a new spec. Every id is snake_case English. Aliases (es/en) are matched after normalization: Unicode NFKD, strip combining marks, lowercase, replace every character that is not a-z or 0-9 with a space, collapse runs of spaces, trim. Ids are compared with the same normalization (pick_up -> 'pick up'). Tones are always [light, base, shade].

text.fontStack: "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, system-ui, sans-serif

es: fuera de escena a la izquierda
fuera de escena a la derecha

grin.description: Squinted happy eyes, huge open grin showing teeth.

sad.description: Eyebrows up in the middle, down-turned mouth.

sob.description: Eyes squeezed shut, wide wobbling open mouth.

annoyed.description: Half-lidded eyes, slanted brows, tight mouth.

furious.description: Brows in a deep V, bared clenched teeth.

wide.description: Round wide eyes, small round mouth.

shocked.description: Tiny pupils in huge eyes, mouth open in a tall oval.

worried.description: Brows tilted up, eyes darting, wavy mouth.

terrified.description: Huge eyes, pinpoint pupils, wavy open mouth with chattering teeth.

bounce.description: Whole body hops in place in a short squash-and-stretch rhythm.

sparkles.description: Four-point star sparkles pop around the head and fade.

droop.description: Shoulders and head sag; arms hang lower; slower idle.

tears.description: Single drops fall from the eyes now and then.

tear_streams.description: Two exaggerated arcs of tears gush sideways from the eyes.

red_face.description: Head tones swap to a red ramp that rises from the chin.

shake.description: Fists clenched, body vibrates a few pixels side to side.

steam.description: Puffs of steam shoot from the top of the head in bursts.

jump_back.description: Quick hop backwards with arms thrown up (a take).

jaw_drop.description: Jaw drops far below the head; at intensity 3 it reaches the ground, then snaps back.

eyes_pop.description: Eyes shoot forward out of the head on short stalks and spring back.

sweat_drops.description: Sweat drops fly off the head in small arcs.

tremble.description: Knees knock and the whole body jitters.

pale_face.description: Head tones swap to a pale blue-white ramp.

hair_stand.description: Hair (or fur) shoots straight up and slowly settles.

approximations.note: There is no dance action; a spinning jump is the closest move.
There is no climbing; a high jump replaces it.
People and land animals cannot fly; a high jump replaces it. A bird already flies when it runs.
There is no swimming; the character walks along the shore.
A kick is shown as tossing the held item to someone.
There is no lie-down action; a soft faint leaves the character lying.
Sneak behind a front-layer piece or off stage.
There is no eating; pick up the food or cup and react happily.
A happy split jump.
There are no rideable vehicles; a fast run replaces the ride.
A wave toward the other character.
Laughter is a talk beat with a laughing line and happy intensity 3.
Crying is a reaction beat with sad intensity 3.
Use a reaction beat (no action) with a target to look at.
There is no push; an accusing point is the closest.
Shown as happy.
Shown as a mild sad droop.
Shown as mildly scared (sweat drop).
Pair it with walk variant strut.
Pair it with a think beat.
Use girl with height tall for a teenage girl.
Use girl with height short for a baby girl.
Only dog, cat and bird exist; a large four-legged animal is drawn as a large dog.
A small four-legged animal is drawn as a small cat.
All birds share one bird body; pick the closest plumage color.
Not available. Ask the user which catalog animal should play that role, or drop it.
Only real beings are allowed. Propose a real person or animal for the same role and tell the user; if the being is central to the plot, ask before writing the script.
Use park and add buildings or fences as pieces.
Use plain with sand and rock pieces.
Use forest and add a water piece.
Outside: city with shop pieces. Inside: room with shelf pieces.
Not available. Ask the user for a catalog place.
There is no dawn palette; sunset is the closest.
dusk is the darkest palette.
There is no weather; use day and add cloud pieces.
Toys are drawn as a ball.
Food is drawn as an apple.
Flat paper objects are drawn as a letter.
